move: four hard cuts, white flash, masked type snaps up, image punch-in
how: Four full-frame cuts (two videos, two images, each with a multiply colour tint and vignette) hard-cut at 0, 0.26D, 0.5D and 0.74D via opacity sets. On each cut a white .flash fades from 0.9 to 0 in 0.18s, the media eases from scale 1.18 to 1.02 with power2.out over the cut, the uppercase words snap up out of overflow-hidden line masks (yPercent 110→0 expo.out, stagger 0.07) while the word block eases from scale 1.06, and a tag slides in from x:-40. Cut 3 draws a white bar with scaleX expo.out then wipes it out from the right. A logo drops in at 0.04D and the final words shove up out with expo.in at 0.94D so the loop flashes back to cut 1.
adapt: Replace the four backgrounds (video or image), tint colours, the word lines per cut, tag and logo strings; cut windows are the cuts array so count and timing can change. Keep the 0.18s flash, the 1.18→1.02 punch and the expo.out mask reveals.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .cut blocks, .logo and .flash from shot.cuts and waits on video loadeddata; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with cut windows as fractions of D and keeps the empty-target tween whose onUpdate sets video.currentTime for scrubbing. Scope all selectors to el.
caveats: video scrubbing via currentTime in onUpdate; needs loaded media before first frame
mix-blend-mode multiply tint over video is a render cost
